title: record-verdict in a main-tree (no-worktree) build binds the verdict to the EMPTY-input hash, so verdict-current reports 'unchanged' after code is fixed — stale verdict carries forward
detail: Observed 2026-10-25, sprint deferred-tier-destination (solo, built in the main tree, no worktrees/): conventions-enforcer's recorded verdict is bound to hash e3b0c44298fc1c14 (sha256 of empty input) because the substantive-hash source for a reviewer verdict is the worktrees artifact, empty in a main-tree build. verdict-current would then match after ANY later code change, letting a FAIL/PASS verdict carry forward across a fix — the content-addressed re-gating (v0.10.0 Fix 3) degrades to always-current. Engine self-builds are routinely main-tree. Suggest: hash the actually-changed set (git diff vs sprint base) when worktrees/ is empty, and refuse to record a verdict against the empty hash (fail closed).

resolution.verify: CUR=$(prusik --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' '0.224.0' "$CUR" | sort -V | head -1)" = '0.224.0' ] && echo "1 passed: engine carries moat-proven fix fb-3fbf1846ac92 (prusik $CUR >= 0.224.0)"
